aggregate_figures.title: How often does each pattern occur?
aggregate_figures.caption: All 51 matches, regulation and extra time; one row per actual rolling motif. Overlapping motifs are included and are not independent chances. Three-pass motifs are a selected subset of chains that survived through a third completed pass.

aggregate_figures.title: Frequency, total threat and shot quality are separate measures
aggregate_figures.caption: From the final receipt to the end of the same provider possession, stopping earlier at opponent control, goal or observed period end. All three panels use the same complete-observation cohort. No shot means xG=0; unknown observations stay missing. xG per shot is a ratio over shot links, not an average over non-shooting motifs.

aggregate_figures.title: What differs from four distinct players?
aggregate_figures.caption: Raw differences versus ABCD, with both sides jointly resampled. A difference in xG per motif may arise from shot frequency, number of shots and/or shot quality. The ratio xG/shot is recomputed inside every bootstrap replicate; intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous tests.
aggregate_figures.reason: Aggregate analytical comparison; no event/sequence rows or learned-parameter file.

aggregate_figures.title: Does the source-xG difference remain after context adjustment?
aggregate_figures.caption: New conditional q models fit source xG sum and shot occurrence separately for each pass length and horizon. Full-possession xG models do not consistently beat a training-mean MSE baseline; treat adjusted contrasts as exploratory sensitivity. Initial and completion adjustments answer different descriptive questions. Completion/geometry can remove part of the motif's spatial pathway. These are residual associations, not causal effects.

aggregate_figures.title: How the time horizon changes the observed opportunities
aggregate_figures.caption: Both horizons start at the final receipt and use the same new provider-possession boundary rule. Thus the 10-second values need not equal the earlier step-4 bounded-continuous-play results. Natural period end closes a remaining-possession window; an unresolved file tail is censored.

aggregate_figures.title: Does crediting overlapping motifs change apparent shot quality?
aggregate_figures.caption: The primary xG/shot denominator is the number of motif–shot links, which preserves the xG/motif decomposition. The sensitivity deduplicates UUIDs within each order/pattern/policy/horizon. The same physical shot may still support different patterns. Both use shared match/possession resampling; credits must not be added as independent chances.
